notes.title: 2025 Chinese New Year Update
notes.notes:
Updated "Spring Festival Mode", which is a small easter egg that can be unlocked after completing one playthrough.

To summarize some recent updates:
1. Support windowed mode and changing resolution, if your computer performance is not enough or you feel 3D dizziness, you can try it.
2. Support volume setting.
3. Except for the operation of the game's secondary menu, all operations have been adapted to the controller.

Performance tips:
If you use a 4K monitor and NVIDIA graphics card to play, it is recommended to adjust DLSS to "Balanced" in the graphics settings.
If your computer is older or thin and light, it is recommended to update the graphics driver and select the second startup option when starting the game.
